**Finding submitted: deviation at § 11.1 (p0045).**

Section 11 is mostly acceptable — 11.2 already provides 30-day return of Customer Data in a complete, commonly used, machine-readable format (and bars withholding over fee disputes), and 11.3 provides secure deletion with written officer certification. The problem is isolated to 11.1, which is our walk-away position: immediate discontinuation of all assistance, no export or migration support, and permanent deletion of Customer Data on termination. It also directly contradicts 11.2/11.3 and § 10.1's reference to "any agreed transition period."

The redline (validated `ok:true`) replaces only the offending sentence, giving us up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates on request, and making deletion subject to 11.2 and 11.3 — the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position without disturbing the already-compliant return and certification mechanics. The comment flags 90 days as an available fallback.
